title_en: The Path of Growth in Academic Writing
story_zh: 李明最初写论文时，逻辑模糊，结构缺乏合理。通过分析优秀论文，他逐步掌握了学术写作的程序：先确定主题和观点，再制定提纲，结合数据进行分析，从而形成深刻的结论。持续练习后，他的写作能力显著成长，最终发表了一篇体现全面思考的论文，取得了重要成就。
story_pinyin: Lǐ Míng zuìchū xiě lùnwén shí, luójí móhu, jiégòu quēfá hélǐ. Tōngguò fēnxī yōuxiù lùnwén, tā zhúbù zhǎngwòle xuéshù xiězuò de chéngxù: xiān quèdìng zhǔtí hé guāndiǎn, zài zhìdìng tígāng, jiéhé shùjù jìnxíng fēnxī, cóng'ér xíngchéng shēnkè de jiélùn. Chíxù liànxí hòu, tā de xiězuò nénglì xiǎnzhù chéngzhǎng, zuìzhōng fābiǎole yī piān tǐxiàn quánmiàn sīkǎo de lùnwén, qǔdéle zhòngyào chéngjiù.
story_en: When Li Ming first wrote his thesis, his logic was blurred and the structure lacked rationality. By analyzing excellent papers, he gradually mastered the procedure of academic writing: first determine the theme and viewpoint, then formulate an outline, combine data for analysis, thus forming a profound conclusion. After continuous practice, his writing ability grew significantly, and he finally published a paper that reflected comprehensive thinking, achieving important accomplishments.
